web_app:
  image: "nginx:alpine"
  container_name: web
  ports:
    - "8080:80"
    - "8443:443"
  environment:
    - DATABASE_URL=${Postgres/url}
    - STATIC_VALUE=plain
  volumes:
    - ./site:/usr/share/nginx/html
    - ./conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d
  networks:
    - frontend
    - backend
  restart: always
